about: Labels settled by tracing the cause; they override run history in src/eval/dataset.ts. A label with planHash applies only to that exact plan. No personal data here.

labels.label: clean
labels.why: Procol behaves correctly. The stored plan (compiled 2026-10-04 by the fast model) sends extend_round = PATCH /trade/:id {increase_auction_time}, which extends the bid end and is rightly accepted; the case is about MOVING a started round's window ({bid_start_time, bid_end_time}), which Procol refuses with 258 — as the earlier library plan showed on 3-4 Oct. Reporting it as a product failure is a false alarm caused by the plan's wrong operation.

labels.label: bug
labels.why: The 500 is BUG-39 (conversion crashes on malformed details, verified 3 Oct 2026). The stored plan meant the happy path but replays library EDGE-DAUC-001, the 'unknown auction type must not 500' robustness request (unknown type, a delivery location that does not exist), so the crash it reports is that known bug — a true detection, under a plan that does not test what its case says.
labels.by: spine.ai eval (traced from the plan and the bug sheet)
